description: The core PR gate's profile (tap#366; narrowed to fixtures only by tap#638): core + the three fixture plugins the core suite is built on, and nothing else. Product components (github_core and the substrate plugins it depends on) are proven in their products' lanes, not here. Bounded by tap/tests/test_core_ci_profile.py, which refuses any plugin that is not a fixture; the profile owns its own pins (scripts/release-plugin.sh bumps every record naming a released slug). Seeds validation_sample's GRIFT so the cold-boot gate's strict seed step imports a real bundle; the core contract suite (tap_plugins/tests/test_plugin_contract.py) exercises each installed fixture end to end; fires no collectors (the cold-boot gate drives the grid_fixtures canary itself).

plugins.note: Fixture: the neutral grid_fixtures__* vocabulary the core suites build fixtures from (tap.plugin_testing.BASELINE_PLUGIN_SLUGS).
Fixture: the Gridkin scenario corpus + harness that exercise the Gryphon query language; owns no types, depends_on grid_fixtures.
Fixture: the in-tree validate_plugin test target (tap_plugin.validation_sample); ships one GRIFT bundle (seeded below) so the seed path and the GRIFT contract run on a fixture; no deps.
